data.narrative: Module 08 completed the capstone deployment and verification suite for the URL shortener service, uniting multi-stage containerization, sequential CI gates, fail-fast configuration, Prometheus observability, fail-closed failure handling, circuit breakers, and runbooks into a fully verified production rollout architecture. Implemented rolling deployment strategy with automated rollback triggered by deep readiness and error-rate gates, verified /health vs /ready separation, and created automated smoke verification. A complete fresh verification pass confirmed clean lint, clean build, all 13 Jest suites passing 78 tests, valid fail-fast startup behavior, and explicit boundaries for unexecuted live Docker and PostgreSQL checks.

dimension_scores.observation: Container packaging, non-root runtime, and immutable image tagging were fully integrated into deployment and rollback automation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Dockerfile builds multi-stage Debian-slim runtime under 512 MiB with unprivileged appuser; deploy-and-verify-notes.md enforces immutable commit-SHA tags and verified rollback tags.

dimension_scores.observation: CI/CD pipeline incorporates pre-deploy quality gates, atomic rolling deployment, and automated post-deployment smoke verification.
dimension_scores.evidence: Sequential pipeline gates lint, compilation, 13 Jest test suites, and security audits before image creation; smoke-verify.ps1 automates post-deploy health, readiness, and metrics verification before traffic shift.

dimension_scores.observation: Observability instrumented across request counters, duration histograms, process memory metrics, and automated rollback alerting.
dimension_scores.evidence: Prometheus metrics expose bounded request and overflow counters; HighErrorRate and HighMemoryUsage alerts are mapped to automated incident and rollback procedures.

dimension_scores.observation: Anticipated and diagnosed critical deployment failure modes including shallow readiness false-positives, creeping memory leaks, and out-of-band config drift.
dimension_scores.evidence: break-diagnosis.md and fix-and-verification.md systematically remediated unapplied migrations masking under SELECT 1, connection listener memory leaks, and manual UI configuration mutations.

dimension_scores.observation: Preserved strict fail-closed security for authentication and critical mutations while enforcing bounded readiness timeouts.
dimension_scores.evidence: ready.controller.ts bounds database and Redis checks to 2,000 ms with withTimeout, preventing slow dependencies from causing container flapping or hung probes during deployment.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored comprehensive deployment notes, automated verification scripts, and capstone reflection synthesizing all eight modules.
dimension_scores.evidence: deploy-and-verify-notes.md, smoke-verify.ps1, verify-deployment.md, and module-08-reflection.md provide complete, tested, copy-pasteable operational procedures with strict NOT EXECUTED boundaries.

strengths: End-to-end production readiness architecture uniting containerization, CI/CD, fail-fast configuration, observability, resilience, runbooks, and verified deployments.
Clear separation of liveness (/health) from readiness (/ready) with bounded 2,000 ms dependency timeouts to prevent black-hole traffic routing.
Automated post-deployment smoke verification script (smoke-verify.ps1) and sub-2-minute automated rollback strategy.
Disciplined distinction between local verified evidence and unavailable live infrastructure (Docker/PostgreSQL).
data.recommendation: Maintain operational excellence by conducting regular GameDay incident drills, enforcing GitOps PR requirements for configuration changes, and expanding smoke tests to cover new business routes as the API evolves.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Selected Option A (rolling) to avoid doubling connection pools and compute resources, pairing it with expand-contract migration discipline and automated rollback.
Exposed lightweight /health and /live for process liveness while reserving /ready for bounded PostgreSQL and Redis dependency verification.

concepts_demonstrated.concept: Post-deploy verification and definition of done
concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Defined done as passing readiness, automated functional smoke verification on business routes, and a 15-30 minute metric soak observation window.
Explicitly distinguished passing local unit/mocked suites and startup drills from unexecuted live container and PostgreSQL checks.

teaching_approaches.detail: Analyzed Knight Capital interlude failure modes and demonstrated how immutable commit tags and automated rollback scripts prevent catastrophic release failures.

teaching_approaches.concept: Shallow readiness vs functional smoke testing
teaching_approaches.detail: Walked through the failure scenario where SELECT 1 succeeds despite missing tables or mismatched secrets, demonstrating the necessity of post-deploy business smoke checks.

learning_style_signals: Uses concrete command output and test assertions to separate verified behavior from runtime assumptions.
Uses exact command output and failure-first tests to distinguish local evidence from unobserved live-system behavior.

public_evidence.artifact: Production Readiness Module 08 Capstone Deployment & Verification Suite
public_evidence.student_action: Designed and verified complete zero-downtime rolling deployment architecture with automated readiness gating, smoke verification scripting, and sub-2-minute rollback.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Authored deploy-and-verify-notes.md, smoke-verify.ps1, verify-deployment.md, and module-08-reflection.md; updated health.controller.ts with /live alias; verified 2,000 ms readiness bounds and Prometheus telemetry.
public_evidence.proof: Lint and Nest build exited 0; all 13 Jest test suites passed 78 tests across 5 groups; startup fail-fast verified missing DATABASE_URL (exit 1), invalid NODE_ENV (exit 1), and redacted production error output; docker info and TCP 5432 checks documented with explicit NOT EXECUTED live boundaries.
public_evidence.ability: Designs, deploys, verifies, and operates resilient cloud-native backend services with end-to-end production readiness.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Proves senior-level production competence across containerization, CI/CD, configuration hygiene, observability, resilience engineering, operational runbooks, and deployment verification.
